title: Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention for Efficient Inference in T2I/T2V Diffusion Transformers

review.finding: Offline calibration builds reusable high-mass block masks; frozen DiTs use a sparse sink branch plus a pooled-KV compensation branch.
review.classification_rationale: The method preserves existing high-mass support for inference acceleration. It neither trains a sink-free model nor adds learned prefix tokens.
review.limits: The source uses sink broadly for recurring high-mass support, not necessarily semantically irrelevant tokens. Masks omit some useful context; compensation matters most at aggressive sparsity.

title: Before Attention Sinks Form: Hidden-State Geometry Reveals and Modulates Their Formation

review.finding: Norm-matched singular-value interventions after a layer alter later position-0 sink behavior while preserving the current layer's attention.
review.classification_rationale: Pre-sink spectral geometry is a mechanistic subtopic, not automatically Geometric Anchoring. Diagnostic causal edits are not presented as a validated mitigation policy.
review.limits: Effects and their signs depend on model and cohort. Some models lack an identifiable pre-sink interval; longer contexts can remove onset variation.

title: Attention Sinks in VLMs Are Borrowed, Not Seen

review.finding: Centered alignment with the text-sink key identifies visual sinks. A key-direction edit cleans the map used for an entropy-triggered crop-and-relook procedure.
review.classification_rationale: The edit calibrates an existing model's attention; it is not training prevention. The shared text-sink key direction supports Implicit Attention Bias.
review.limits: Removed visual attention mostly returns to the text sink rather than the target. Gemma-4 reads its visual sinks; small sink-free models can be harmed. The answering pass is unedited.

title: Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty

publication.label: ArXiv
publication.authors_publication_note: This paper has been accepted as poster at Neurips 2026

review.finding: A probability-weighted Token Difference Operator separates sink-biased column mass from centered routing structure and supports an uncertainty estimator.
review.classification_rationale: Operator geometry is retained as its own mechanistic subtopic. Geometric language alone does not justify the narrower Geometric Anchoring category.
review.limits: High sink mass need not imply routing collapse; output dimensionality also depends on values. Uncertainty estimation does not demonstrate sink removal or improved generation accuracy.

title: Underscoring the Problem: Why Softpick Fails at Initialization

review.finding: Separating Softpick's forward and backward denominators exposes zero-support rows and tests a stop-gradient variant retaining the full forward denominator.
review.classification_rationale: Modified normalization and its training gradient belong to Modified Softmax Functions. Gradient-path failure is retained as a distinct mechanistic subtopic.
review.limits: The comparison is small-scale with one checkpoint per cell. Retrieval gains at 230M do not establish general long-context robustness; both stable operators fail beyond training context.

title: Decoding the Functional Roles of Register and High-Norm Patch Tokens in Vision Transformers

review.finding: Token-specific SAEs and latent interventions compare register features with high-norm patch features in DINOv2, exposing different representation-stability effects.
review.classification_rationale: Included as related register/outlier functional evidence. The source does not identify a complete sink-routing circuit, so the label remains Other Mechanistic Interpretations.
review.limits: Reported semantic and causal analyses focus on DINOv2 Small layer 8. High norm, SAE semantics, and attention sinks must not be treated as equivalent; qualitative visualizations are exploratory.

title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation

review.finding: Continuation and perturbation studies separate decay-driven activation-scale turnover, stochastic channel identity, collective RMS effects, and AdamW-supported maintenance of a sink-associated cohort.
review.classification_rationale: Outlier dynamics and joint channel ablations inform Outlier Circuits. Optimizer analyses are not a demonstrated sink-free optimizer proposal.
review.limits: Magnitude-matched controls are strongest in small, weakly isolated models. The mechanism selecting eventual surviving channels remains unresolved.

title: Which the Eye Fears: Writing with Read-Blindness Explains Massive Activations in Transformers

review.finding: Massive coordinates show asymmetric read/write access. Orthogonal or frozen read projections cause blindness to move to other pathways rather than remove massive activations.
review.classification_rationale: Projection, FFN, and optimizer analyses concern outlier mechanisms. Partial suppression under a diagnostic intervention is not coded as a successful sink-removal technique.
review.limits: Massive-activation maintenance is not proof of a universal function of attention sinks. Local loss geometry and next-step optimizer evidence do not by themselves establish global training dynamics.

title: TSGate: Timestep-Aware Gated Attention for Diffusion Transformers

review.finding: TSGate adds a timestep-conditioned offset to content gate logits before scaling value-aggregated attention features, addressing template sinks and weak early text interaction.
review.classification_rationale: This is trained output-feature gating. Its time bias is not a bias on attention logits, and the gate does not renormalize the current attention matrix.
review.limits: Sink suppression alone does not restore early text guidance or generation quality. Reported gains concern the evaluated prompt formats and DiT recipe.

title: Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization

publication.label: ArXiv
publication.authors_publication_note: Accepted for publication at IEEE IECON 2026. 6 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables

review.finding: NF4 quantization preserves global BOS-sink head rankings better than discrete top-k sets; calibration-domain shifts and layer-local drift can be substantial.
review.classification_rationale: Included as sink-topology deployment evidence. Measuring or recalibrating sink maps is not sink mitigation, and no subtype is forced onto the study.
review.limits: Three small models, one quantizer and domain pair; topology churn is not shown to impair downstream task quality. Calibration sample sufficiency is an empirical plateau criterion, not a universal threshold.

title: ValueDiff: Value-Geometric KV Cache Eviction for Sink-Suppressed LLMs

review.finding: ValueDiff retains geometrically distinctive cached values using distance from their mean, motivated by changing key/value geometry in sink-suppressed models.
review.classification_rationale: Included as sink-dependent inference research. None of the four utilization subtypes precisely describes value-based eviction without sink preservation, so those labels remain unassigned.
review.limits: The method does not train away sinks. Benefits relative to key-based eviction depend on BOS geometry and relative value dispersion; the source reports exceptions.

title: Abstention and Noise Filtering: Two Missing Primitives of Softmax Attention

publication.label: ArXiv
publication.authors_publication_note: 20 pages (8 pages main text plus appendices), 5 figures, 12 tables

review.finding: Controlled attention variants separate routing abstention from content-dependent value filtering, comparing gates, off-by-one normalization, and learned sink logits.
review.classification_rationale: A fixed null denominator, a learnable per-head null logit, and value gates support distinct mitigation labels. Their benefits overlap partly rather than being identical.
review.limits: Value-only gates can retain position-0 attention sinks. Results vary with scale, so gate placement and sink counts cannot be collapsed into one explanation.

title: Layers, Sinks, and Scaling: Adaptive Evidence Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models

review.finding: AREA filters sink-contaminated visual relevance, scales crops/evidence using entropy, and uses sink mass to gate intervention in frozen MLLMs.
review.classification_rationale: Sink-aware relevance calibration belongs to Attention Redistribution. It changes evidence presentation rather than transferring attention mass directly or updating weights.
review.limits: Activation-based sink detection and layer groups are backbone-specific. Visual intervention can substitute a crop for the original image; the full policy includes textual refresh and stream-history thresholds.

title: It's Not RoPE that Creates Sinks: The Role of Self-Concentration and Value-Non-Mixing in Attention

review.finding: Forcing self-concentration at a later position creates sinks and massive activations. Repeated-token experiments probe value non-mixing without forced self-attention.
review.classification_rationale: Value non-mixing is preserved as a specific mechanistic explanation; the study does not introduce a trained sink-removal method.
review.limits: Key-side RoPE perturbations have limited effects under the tested intervention; this does not exclude all positional mechanisms. Repeated-token support is weaker and input-dependent in two of five models.

title: SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models

review.finding: SinkPruner pools high-norm visual outliers into a proxy, selects diverse remaining tokens, then applies text-guided pruning in the frozen MLLM.
review.classification_rationale: This is sink-aware token-selection calibration within Attention Redistribution, not explicit mass-preserving transfer or training-based mitigation.
review.limits: High norm is an operational detector, not a universal sink definition. The method retains a pooled outlier proxy; it does not simply remove every sink-associated state.

title: Hybrid Gated Attention

review.finding: HyGA fuses input-based and post-attention gates with cross-head modulation, and combines them with a learnable null sink for stability.
review.classification_rationale: Content/output gates and a GPT-OSS-style learnable sink are separate architectural components; the latter is a null bias rather than a learnable prefix token.
review.limits: The paper does not establish that gating alone eliminates all sinks. Gate fusion avoids excessive attenuation, and capability gains reflect the combined design.

title: Text Template Tokens Are Implicit Semantic Registers in Diffusion Transformers

review.finding: Template sinks acquire semantics through the image stream inside the DiT despite weakly semantic input embeddings. Causal head analysis motivates training-free head pruning.
review.classification_rationale: The efficiency method reuses sink/register-associated functional structure rather than eliminating it. Implicit semantic registers are retained as a fine-grained mechanistic label.
review.limits: Register function depends on head, depth, and trajectory. A template-sink ranking prunes more load-bearing heads than the proposed semantic-attention ranking; perceptual quality drops faster than object accuracy.

title: LASER: A Corrective Lens for LVLMs via Visual Attention Preservation and Sink Suppression

publication.label: ArXiv
publication.authors_publication_note: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)

review.finding: LASER trains with GRPO rewards combining sustained non-sink visual attention and suppression of disproportionate visual sink attention, gated by answer correctness.
review.classification_rationale: Sink-dependent reinforcement-learning rewards are a tuning intervention under Other Mitigation Techniques. The method is not a training-free attention edit.
review.limits: High-activation dimensions define candidate sinks in the evaluated backbones. Grounding rewards alone can increase sink attention, so the combined result cannot be attributed to visual persistence alone.

title: Information-Regularized Attention for Visual-Centric Reasoning

review.finding: IRA uses a learned stochastic value-state representation and uncertainty-weighted KL regularization during full-parameter SFT; the reported sink ratio decreases relative to ordinary SFT.
review.classification_rationale: Fine-tuning auxiliary regularization and value modification fit Other Mitigation Techniques. The evaluated method is neither training-free nor a pre-training intervention.
review.limits: The paper evaluates models up to 8B and uses a particular layer-averaged visual attention threshold. Larger-scale and pre-training applications are proposed rather than established.

title: Massive Activations Are Architecturally Robust: A Controlled Scratch/Commitment Residual Stream Test

review.finding: Ledger Residuals introduce a protected decode-only stream, but start-token fixed-dimension outliers reappear there; stricter commit sparsity increases their concentration.
review.classification_rationale: This is a negative architectural test of an outlier hypothesis, not evidence that the proposed protected stream successfully mitigates sinks.
review.limits: One seed per configuration at 160M/290M; outlier statistics are not equivalent to direct attention-sink measurement. The study does not distinguish sink, bias, and gradient-regulation functions.

title: A Unifying View of Attention Sinks: From Mechanisms to Architectural Interventions

review.finding: Value interventions distinguish near-null NOP sinks from nonzero broadcast sinks in pretrained ViTs. Gating and a penalized position-free global pathway reorganize these computations.
review.classification_rationale: NOP supports the softmax/no-op category; broadcast is retained as a fine-grained mechanistic tag. Output gating, the common-mode training penalty, and the global pathway support the three mitigation labels respectively.
review.limits: Registers relocate both regimes. Gating increases broadcast-like sinks in the tested ViT; fewer sinks alone do not imply better representations. The v2 title replaces Two Algorithms, Two Solutions.

title: When Do Attention Circuits Form? Developmental Trajectories of Capability and Attention-Sink Emergence Across Three 1B-ClassArchitectures

review.finding: A developmental checkpoint panel finds model-dependent BOS-attractor trajectories and mid-layer-outward emergence in Pythia, OLMo, and OLMoE.
review.classification_rationale: Training-dynamics observations inform mechanistic interpretation; checkpoint tracking is not itself a pre-training mitigation intervention.
review.limits: Claims depend on the selectivity threshold and checkpoint grid. Data, architecture, and training budgets co-vary; the panel does not isolate a general causal effect of corpus or MoE design.

title: Massive Spikes in LLMs are Bias Vectors: Mechanistic Uncovering and Spike-Free Quantization

review.finding: Post-normalization spike states act as bias prototypes with sink keys and near-null values. InsertQuant clamps spikes but reinstates calibrated K/V templates and terminal residual effects.
review.classification_rationale: Bias-vector geometry and value drains support the interpretation labels. Restoring the sink's functional K/V effect is preservation, even though activation spikes are removed during PTQ.
review.limits: Spike-free quantization is not equivalent to training a sink-free model. Prototype rigidity and RoPE stability are properties of the tested models, not universal semantic irrelevance of sinks.

title: Attention Sinks and Outliers in Attention Residuals

publication.label: ArXiv
publication.authors_publication_note: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 40 (NeurIPS) 2026

review.finding: OASIS adds Softmax1 null routes at token and depth levels, then adjusts depth logits using centered token-level null probabilities.
review.classification_rationale: Softmax1 supplies explicit null capacity; token-to-depth coupling is retained as a separate mitigation detail. It changes trained routing rather than reusing existing sink positions.
review.limits: Earlier omission: first submitted in May, revised in September. Null routing attenuates real branch contributions; a depth null route is not automatically an identity residual. Theory is conditional and sink visualizations are partly qualitative.
